title: polypodium lineare subsp. loriforme
intro: Polypodium lineare subsp. loriforme, commonly known as Loriform Polypodium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern that has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Loriform Polypodium include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
